gloss: fond of cleanliness; neat freak; tidy person

definitions.gloss: fond of cleanliness; neat freak; tidy person
definitions.explanation: a personality trait describing someone who likes things to be clean and orderly

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{綺麗好|きれいず}きだ。

examples.english: Living with a tidy person requires being careful.
My mother likes things neat, so there are always flowers arranged in the house.

notes:
A compound noun used as a personality descriptor. Can be used both positively (someone who keeps things nice) and with a hint of exasperation (someone overly particular about cleanliness). Functions as both a noun (a neat person) and a na-adjective modifier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {綺麗好|きれいず}きな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a tidy/clean person
- {綺麗好|きれいず}きな⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: a tidy personality
- ⟦かなり→かなり：01149_kanari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{綺麗好|きれいず}き: quite the neat freak

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {潔癖症|けっぺきしょう}: germaphobe, obsessive cleanliness — much stronger, implies a disorder
- ⟦{几帳面|きちょうめん}→几帳面：06868_kichoumen⟧: meticulous, precise — broader than just cleanliness, includes punctuality and organization

FORMS:
{綺麗|きれい} (clean, beautiful) + {好|ず}き (fond of). Same pattern as {寂|さび}し⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧, {怖|こわ}⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧, ⟦{甘党|あまとう}→甘党：08339_amatou⟧, etc. — personality words built from preferences.
